name: Oakhaven
core_statement: Oakhaven is a coastal city built on inherited lies.
narrative_principle: No generation knows the complete truth.

historical_layers.name: The Illegal Foundation
historical_layers.description: A fishing village was dispossessed and land ownership deeds were falsified by the Pike family.

historical_layers.name: The Industrial Cover-Up
historical_layers.description: A labor conflict was triggered by a misunderstanding of records originating from 1856.

historical_layers.name: The Bureaucratic Erasure
historical_layers.description: City archives were purged and media records were manipulated during Oakhaven's modernization.

historical_layers.name: The Current Tragedies
historical_layers.description: Modern killings are driven by panic and attempts to suppress old records connected to Oakhaven's inherited lies.
